text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks by thinking about what could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to create contingency plans, which are backup plans for when something unexpected occurs. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation. Risks can change over time, so regular checks help you respond quickly. Good risk management does not remove all danger, but it helps you stay prepared and calm.
